## Visual evidence

Attach relevant screenshots for visible changes. For navigation changes, include a short video or a screenshot sequence showing the flow. Embed media in the description or link to an attachment in a PR comment; do not reference local-only files. Prefer synthetic or placeholder photos.

- [ ] Visual evidence is attached and opens correctly, or this PR has no visual changes (explain).
- [ ] For a final stage checkpoint, evidence covers that stage's delivered UI and navigation; earlier PR evidence is linked when reused.
